description: MY STORY I'M MARY PELTOLA I’m running for Senate because I’ve seen firsthand how government is failing Alaskans.I grew up on the Kuskokwim, fishing salmon with my father. Buzzy and I raised our seven kids here and spent long summer days at fish camp. Fishing with family is where Alaskans learn life’s lessons.Life is difficult

title: My Story - Mary Peltola
